about.text: The popular soured milk of Rwanda: raw milk left to sour for two to three days in a smoked wooden jar or gourd, giving a thick, tangy, lightly smoky drink.

links.name: Karenzi et al. 2013, Biotechnol. Agron. Soc. Environ. 17(2)

facts.v: Some makers boil and cool the milk first, then 24–36 h to set
In a gourd for at least 2 h gives buttermilk (amacunda) and butter (amavuta)
